No, that's not what the tool found. It made no observation at all, so it can't say whether loss occurred.

The assessment is "insufficient evidence" because the source coverage this asset needs hasn't been prepared. Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021 were all unavailable for ASSET-J. The claim covered tree-cover loss across the whole asset boundary for 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, after the 2020-12-31 baseline.

The evidence does not establish:
- that no tree-cover loss occurred;
- that tree-cover loss occurred;
- any regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant, non-compliant or deforestation-free.

Treat the question as unanswered. Answering it would require preparing the missing source coverage and rerunning the assessment. The evidence reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12 (version 1, current).
